preview.text: Northern Districts faces Auckland in a one-day match at Bay Oval, where the usual first-innings score in the 13 recorded one-day matches is 261. Auckland won the toss and chose to bowl first. The forecast for the next 8 hours is up to a 2 per cent chance of rain and about 17 degrees.

summary.text: Auckland won by 4 wkts after restricting ND to 167-10, where Xavier Bell top-scored with 46 off 57 balls and Angus Olliver took 3 for 23. Auckland then reached 170-6 in their innings, led by top scorer and captain Sean Solia with 54 off 77 balls, despite Cooper Rowell taking 2 for 27.
